Give One More Morning a strong start. I want as many streams as possible, and I count a stream when someone opens the release on Sivro Stream—not when they merely visit the landing page. Run the X campaign from Tuesday, January 5, 2027 through Sunday, January 17, 2027, inclusive: 13 days in the account's time zone, Johannesburg time. The landing page is https://sivrocurrent.com/one-more-morning. The site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see the streams. You may launch and manage the campaign independently without asking for my approval. Watch it throughout the flight and make adjustments promptly; I expect active management. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Keep the distinction between those clicks and my counted streams clear.

Here's the exact copy from my landing page:
"I'm Sivro Current, a DJ based in Cape Town, South Africa, and One More Morning is my new four-track melodic house EP, built from dawn field recordings and steady grooves for your New Year resolutions. Stream the full EP free on my browser-based Sivro Stream service through January 17, 2027. Listening is open to all ages worldwide except China, with no account or app required."

Everything is localized: the landing page comes in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see it in their own language.

Total budget: 100.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

**One More Morning — campaign recap (Jan 5–17, 2027, Johannesburg time)**

- **Spend:** $99.50 of your $100.00 budget
- **Impressions:** 413,464
- **Link clicks:** 449 (≈$0.22 per link click)

I ran one Website Clicks campaign optimized for link clicks — the closest available proxy, since the landing page has no X pixel and X therefore cannot see or optimize toward actual Sivro Stream opens. Targeting was worldwide excluding China, electronic‑music interest, no age restriction, using three of your approved posts (the ones naming Sivro Stream / free streaming most explicitly); I monitored throughout, held the creative mix when CPC stayed flat at ~$0.22, and raised the daily cap in the final days to use the budget by Jan 17.

**Important distinction:** those 449 are link clicks to the landing page, *not* your counted streams. A counted stream is someone opening the release on Sivro Stream, which X cannot measure without its pixel — so the true stream total isn't available from X's reporting and shouldn't be read as 449.
